directives.treatmentLabel: Instrument Journalist Capacity and Newsroom Investment Anchors
directives.treatmentDescription: Establish a quantitative newsroom-health anchor for journalism capacity tracking editorial headcount trends, newsroom investment, cost-per-story, and investigative resourcing across publishers (NYT, NWSA, GCI) so the journalism node carries a real capacity index analogous to generation-capacity authority, not a qualitative label.

Track investigative-resource share (FTEs on accountability beats) against total editorial FTEs
Index newsroom closures and news-desert expansion using Medill State of Local News data
Publish a quarterly newsroom-capacity index with confidence bands and revision history

directives.treatmentLabel: Instrument Spectrum Scarcity Indices and Auction Price Anchors
directives.treatmentDescription: Build a spectrum-scarcity price anchor for spectrum management using FCC auction clearing prices, cost per MHz-pop, and unlicensed-band congestion metrics so the spectrum node carries a real price-discovery signal analogous to a commodity price anchor, mapped to the carriers (VZ, T, TMUS) and tower REITs (AMT, CCI, SBAC) bound to it.

Index carrier spectrum-depth (MHz held per band) against subscriber load for VZ, T, TMUS
Publish a spectrum-scarcity index combining clearing price, congestion, and depth-per-sub with revision history

directives.treatmentLabel: Deploy Local-Journalism Sustainability Remedies Against Newsroom Consolidation
directives.treatmentDescription: When newsroom consolidation and local-news desertification exceed threshold, deploy a local-journalism sustainability package - payroll tax credits for editorial employment, philanthropic/public matching funds, and shared investigative cooperatives - to arrest capacity collapse, mirroring how a strategic-reserve remedy answers a supply-capacity shock.
treatmentSteps: Trigger when net local-newsroom closures or editorial headcount decline cross the diagnostic threshold
Design a refundable payroll tax credit scaled to local-editorial FTEs (per Local Journalism Sustainability Act model)
Stand up philanthropic and public matching funds routed through INN/Press Forward-style intermediaries
Form shared investigative cooperatives so small outlets pool accountability reporting capacity
Track recovery via Medill news-desert reversal and Pew newsroom-employment stabilization

directives.treatmentLabel: Deploy Algorithmic Transparency and Feed-Diversity Remedies on Distribution Platforms
directives.treatmentDescription: When recommendation-driven amplification creates a radicalization feedback loop on social distribution platforms (META, GOOGL/YouTube, TikTok), deploy algorithmic-transparency mandates and feed-diversity requirements - recommender audits, exposure-diversity floors, and circuit-breakers on viral harmful content - to dampen the runaway reward loop, mirroring a stability remedy on a positively-fed control system.
treatmentSteps: Trigger when discovery share via recommendation and exposure-homogeneity metrics cross threshold
Mandate independent algorithmic audits of recommender systems (DSA Article 37-style risk assessment)
Impose feed-diversity floors so a minimum share of impressions come from outside the engagement-optimized cluster
Install virality circuit-breakers that throttle algorithmic amplification of flagged harmful content
Pair with media-literacy interventions and evaluate via exposure-diversity and harmful-amplification metrics

directives.treatmentLabel: Strengthen Universal Service Obligation Against Rural Broadband Access Failure
directives.treatmentDescription: When rural and high-cost broadband coverage gaps exceed threshold, strengthen the universal-service obligation - expanded high-cost support, BEAD/RDOF-aligned buildout enforcement, and middle-mile fiber subsidy - to close the last-mile access gap, mirroring a mandated-reserve-margin remedy that guarantees minimum service to underserved load.
treatmentSteps: Trigger when unserved/underserved share in covered geographies crosses the diagnostic threshold
Expand Universal Service Fund / high-cost support tied to enforceable buildout milestones
Align disbursement with BEAD and RDOF location-level commitments and claw back on default
Subsidize middle-mile fiber to lower last-mile economics for carriers (VZ, T, TMUS) and cable (CMCSA, CHTR)
Track closure via FCC National Broadband Map served-location gains
